content:
CCLD = $(CC)
CC = clang
CCDEPMODE = depmode=gcc3
CFLAGS = -O1 -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fdiagnostics-color -D_GNU_SOURCE
CUNIT_CFLAGS =
CUNIT_LIBS = -lcunit
LDFLAGS =
LIBS =
abs_top_builddir = /gt/_work/src
abs_top_srcdir = /gt/_work/src
top_builddir = .
top_srcdir = .
---include---
include/:
coap3
oscore

include/coap3/:
coap.h
coap_address.h
coap_asn1_internal.h
coap_async.h
coap_async_internal.h
